top_choice_rationale: P002 honours a general design principle of self-assembled matter: nucleic acids are entrapped in lipid particles built from pH-switchable ionizable lipids, neutral in blood and cationic in the endosome, where lipid phase behaviour drives fusion and release. The achievement is the carrier, separate from the 2023 Medicine prize for nucleoside-modified mRNA, and its consequences are mature and independently validated. I accept that the Cullis-Madden-Hope allocation is a judgement against MacLachlan, Anderson and Langer. P001 is a close second because its mechanism is well reproduced, though no degrader is approved and credit is crowded. P003 is mature but reads as an extension of the 2010 cross-coupling prize. All three beat no award.
recusal_note: Lipid self-assembly and membranes are my own research area, so I am scientifically close to P002, but I have no personal, collaborative or institutional tie to Cullis, Madden or Hope apparent from my profile; no recusal need is apparent.
